Watch the sunset, grab a drink, and connect with fellow nomads, remote workers, entrepreneurs, and locals from around the world. We would love to hear from you! ***Do you have a venue for 100+ people indoors? Partner with us:*** We have some spots available for venues that would like to host our Thursday meetups. Whether you're a nomad passing through Lisbon, staying for a season, living in Lisbon, or are an aspiring digital nomad, you're all welcome to join our events! **📣 Friendly reminder** Our meetups are all about creating a safe, inclusive, and welcoming space for everyone, even as our community grows. Bring your best vibe, treat others with kindness and respect, and make an effort to greet new faces. Remember, everyone has the right to their boundaries—whether it’s a hug, a dance, a drink, or a conversation. Let’s ensure our community thrives by treating each other as we’d like to be treated. Looking forward to meeting you! ***The Lisbon Digital Nomads Meetup Team*** PS - Join our Slack community [here](http://lisbondigitalnomads.org/slack). title: The Successor of Failures: Learning Product Management by Breaking Startups
description: About the event: For entrerpreneurs, product managers, designers, frontend engineers, founders, and anyone interested. Anyone interested in Product or trying to get into Product Management is welcome. **Why do brilliant ideas and complex systems fail in the real market?** Usually, it comes down to a lack of Product Management. In this candid lecture, Reza Barzegar explores what happens when you learn PM the hard way: by launching startups without studying it first. Drawing from his experiences founding ventures (SaaS for micro-enterprises) in creative industry (Auro Earth and Azgil) and an intelligent apparel recommender system (Dina Mode), Reza breaks down how missing core PM skills directly catalyzed his early failures. More importantly, the talk details how these missteps served as an intense, real-world masterclass. Attendees will learn how untreated assumptions break startups, which critical PM skills must be prioritized, and how to use failure as a diagnostic tool. Ultimately, the session redefines Product Management from a founder’s perspective—not just as feature delivery, but as the essential architecture that connects a business ecosystem to reality. About our speaker: Reza Barzegar is a Product Manager and Venture Architect who specializes in translating complex systems and narrative logic into market-ready products. Coming from a non-technical background, Reza approaches product management as an investigative discipline—leveraging data-driven pattern discovery to bridge the gap between high-level strategy and execution. He holds a Master’s degree in Marketing Management and is currently completing an MSc in Innovation and Research for Sustainability at ISEG, University of Lisbon. As the former founder of startups like Auro Earth, Azgil, and Dina Mode, Reza uses his entrepreneurial background to inform his product philosophy: treating every failure as a vital data point to build more resilient, user-centric business ecosystems.
